title: SoulCommand
description: SoulCommand is a Minecraft 1.21.4 Bukkit plugin that lets hostile mobs temporarily possess players, causing them to lose control and exhibit eerie behaviors before breaking free.
body: SoulCommand is a thrilling Bukkit plugin for Minecraft 1.21.4 that brings a new level of challenge and atmosphere to your server by allowing all hostile mobs to temporarily possess players. Once possessed, players lose control of their movement, emit eerie chat messages, and experience unsettling visual and sound effects—adding a spooky, immersive twist to PvE combat. The possession effect lasts for a configurable duration and can be cleansed early with special items or by defeating the possessing mob. Perfect for adventure, horror, and survival servers seeking to raise the stakes and scare players in a unique way!
